a delicate situation: Telling your best friend that her boyfriend is cheating is a delicate situation that needs to be handled carefully.
告訴你最好的朋友她男友劈腿，是需要小心處理的棘手敏感的情況。
a delicate balance: Students must keep a delicate balance between studying hard and getting enough rest and exercise.
學生必須在用功讀書與獲得充足休息和運動之間保持微妙的平衡。
delicate health: Because of her delicate health, my grandmother catches a cold easily and rarely goes out in winter.
因為體弱多病，我奶奶很容易感冒，冬天很少出門。
a delicate flavor: This tea has a delicate flavor, so don't add sugar or milk, or you won't be able to taste it.
這種茶有清淡細緻的味道，所以別加糖或牛奶，否則你會嘗不出來。
delicate negotiations: After months of delicate negotiations, the two companies finally agreed on a price, though one wrong word could have ended everything.
經過數月需要謹慎處理的談判，兩家公司終於談妥價格，雖然一句錯話就可能讓一切告吹。
delicate skin: Babies have delicate skin, so parents should use gentle soap and protect them from strong sunlight.
嬰兒有嬌嫩的皮膚，所以父母應使用溫和的肥皂，並保護他們避免強烈的陽光。
a delightful evening: We spent a delightful evening at the night market, eating snacks, playing games, and laughing with old friends.
我們在夜市度過一個愉快的夜晚，吃小吃、玩遊戲，和老朋友一起歡笑。
a delightful surprise: Finding a birthday card from my old teacher in the mailbox was a delightful surprise that made my whole day.
在信箱裡發現老恩師寄來的生日卡，是令人欣喜的驚喜，讓我開心了一整天。
a democratic society: In a democratic society, people can vote for their leaders and freely express their opinions without fear.
在民主社會中，人民可以投票選出領導人，並且毫無畏懼地自由表達意見。
democratic elections: After years of military rule, the country finally held democratic elections in which every adult citizen could vote.
經過多年的軍事統治，這個國家終於舉行了每位成年公民都能投票的民主選舉。
a democratic decision: Our class voted on where to go for the trip, and the beach won, so it was a democratic decision.
我們班投票決定校外旅行要去哪裡，結果海邊勝出，所以這是一個民主決定。
the Democratic Party: In the United States, the Democratic Party and the Republican Party are the two main political parties.
在美國，民主黨和共和黨是兩大主要政黨。
dense fog: Dense fog covered the airport this morning, so pilots couldn't see the runway and many flights were delayed.
今天早上濃霧籠罩機場，飛行員看不見跑道，許多班機因此延誤。
a dense forest: The hikers got lost in a dense forest where the trees grew so close together that little sunlight came through.
登山客在一座茂密的森林中迷了路，那裡的樹長得非常密，幾乎透不進陽光。
a dense population: Taipei has a dense population, so apartments are small and the MRT is crowded during rush hour.
台北人口稠密，所以公寓都很小，尖峰時段捷運也很擁擠。
a dense text: This philosophy book is a dense text full of long sentences, and I have to read each page three times.
這本哲學書是艱深難懂的文章，充滿冗長的句子，每頁我都得讀三遍。
be a bit dense: Sorry if I'm being a bit dense, but could you explain the math problem again? I still don't get it.
抱歉我有點笨，但你能再解釋一次這道數學題嗎？我還是不懂。
be dependent on: Many elderly people are dependent on their children for money, meals, and help with daily life.
許多長者在金錢、餐食和日常生活上依賴他們的子女。
a dependent clause: A dependent clause, such as "because it rained," cannot stand alone as a complete sentence.
從屬子句，例如「because it rained」，無法單獨成為完整的句子。
dependent children: Parents with dependent children under eighteen can get extra financial help from the government each year.
有未滿十八歲受撫養子女的父母，每年可以獲得政府額外的經濟補助。
become too dependent: Experts warn that teenagers may become too dependent on their phones and forget how to talk face to face.
專家警告，青少年可能變得太依賴手機，忘了如何面對面交談。
descriptive writing: In descriptive writing, you use details about sights, sounds, and smells to help readers picture a scene clearly.
在描寫性寫作中，你用視覺、聲音和氣味的細節，幫助讀者清楚地想像一個場景。
a descriptive passage: The novel opens with a descriptive passage about the quiet mountain village, its old houses, and its misty morning.
這本小說以一段描述性的段落開場，描寫寧靜的山村、古老的房屋和霧濛濛的清晨。
a desirable outcome: Both sides hope the peace talks will lead to a desirable outcome that ends the fighting for good.
雙方都希望和平談判能帶來一個理想的結果，永久結束戰鬥。
highly desirable: Experience with computers is highly desirable for this job, though it is not required for every applicant.
有電腦經驗對這份工作來說非常令人嚮往，但並非每位應徵者都必須具備。
It is desirable that…: It is desirable that every student wear a helmet when riding a bike to school, even on short trips.
每位學生騎腳踏車上學時都戴安全帽是可取的，即使是短程也一樣。
a desirable neighborhood: They moved to a desirable neighborhood with good schools, quiet streets, and a large park nearby.
他們搬到一個令人憧憬的住宅區，那裡有好學校、安靜的街道，附近還有一座大公園。
be desperate for a job: After being out of work for a year, he was desperate for a job and would accept any offer.
失業一年後，他急需一份工作，任何工作機會他都願意接受。
a desperate attempt: In a desperate attempt to catch the last train, she ran up the stairs, but the doors closed in front of her.
她孤注一擲地想趕上末班車而衝上樓梯，但車門在她面前關上了。
be desperate to win: Our team was desperate to win the championship after losing in the final two years in a row.
在連續兩年於決賽落敗後，我們隊渴望贏得冠軍。
in desperate need of: After the earthquake, thousands of families were in desperate need of food, clean water, and shelter.
地震過後，數千個家庭急需食物、乾淨的水和住所。
desperate measures: Desperate times call for desperate measures, so the shop owner sold his car to keep his business open.
非常時期需要鋌而走險的手段，所以店老闆賣掉車子以維持生意。
a desperate situation: The climbers were in a desperate situation, trapped by a snowstorm with little food and no phone signal.
登山者陷入危急的局面，被暴風雪困住，食物所剩無幾，手機也沒有訊號。
